## Problem

Which agent-debugging task is difficult today? Give a concrete example.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and how a developer would use it.

## Alternatives considered

List existing features or workarounds you tried.

## Success criteria

How would we check that this works? For evaluation changes, describe the workflow, split, baseline, and sample counts. Do not include private traces or credentials.
